items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: he used to call me Kingfish

ctx.x: And so Chief, who had gotten in the band, also played piano and Chief sat in on piano and I contacted Hobart Banks that wouldn't come to New York City with us and when I contacted him--he used to call me Kingfish--he said I'll be waiting on you, Fish.
